title: Chocolate Milk, Reduced Sugar, Fat Free (Skim)

content.title: About
content.content: Reduced‑sugar, fat‑free chocolate milk is a beverage made from skim cow’s milk, cocoa powder and low‑calorie sweeteners, providing a chocolate flavor with less sugar and virtually no fat.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Skim milk retains most nutrients while containing almost no fat.
Sugar reduction is achieved with stevia or erythritol, which do not raise blood glucose.
The cocoa used is rich in flavonoids, known for antioxidant properties.
Athletes and calorie‑conscious consumers often choose this drink.
In many markets it is sold in 250 ml and 1 L cartons.

items.title: High in calcium
items.content: Skim milk provides a substantial amount of calcium, essential for bone and teeth health.

items.title: Low in fat
items.content: The absence of fat makes the drink suitable for low‑calorie diets.

items.title: Reduced sugar
items.content: Lower sugar content helps maintain stable blood glucose levels, beneficial for those with pre‑diabetes.

items.title: Cocoa antioxidants
items.content: Flavonoids from cocoa may support cardiovascular health and improve mood.

items.title: Source of protein
items.content: Milk supplies high‑quality dairy protein that aids tissue repair and satiety.

items.title: Lactose intolerance
items.content: Skim milk contains lactose; individuals with intolerance should opt for lactose‑free versions.

items.title: Milk protein allergy
items.content: Allergic reactions to casein or whey can occur in sensitive people.

items.title: Artificial sweeteners
items.content: Some sweeteners may cause gastrointestinal discomfort when consumed in large amounts.

items.title: Caffeine content
items.content: Cocoa contains a small amount of theobromine, which can affect sleep in sensitive individuals.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Drink it chilled as a refreshing beverage, blend into smoothies, use as a base for protein shakes, or add to oatmeal and cereals for a chocolate flavor.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in the refrigerator at 1 °C–4 °C. Once opened, consume within 5‑7 days. Do not freeze, as texture may change.
